content: Before I print anything, take another look at your design. Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged. I'll print the final part from what you send.

I found two issues to fix: the 114 mm-wide access opening had a roof that exceeded your printer’s proven bridge length, and the perfboard could overlap the disk-mounting posts. I’ve changed the opening to sloped shoulders with a 40 mm top bridge and moved the carrier down.

The unmeasured USB position, PCB thicknesses and rear-component clearances still prevent me from confirming the fit. Those checks remain necessary before final assembly.
